title: Which rationals occur as scl of a chain in a free group?
body:
## The question

Let F be a free group. Which rational numbers occur as scl(C) for a chain C in F?

scl takes only rational values on free groups, and the naive form of the question
is whether every rational at least 1 is attained. Computation suggests a sharper
and rather different answer, recorded separately: that the threshold is 3/4 rather
than 1, and that above 3/4 essentially everything is attained while below it the
spectrum is sparse.

This is the top-level goal of the side project on the scl spectrum, alongside the
construction of explicit extremal quasimorphisms certifying particular values.
author: danny
